description: This file implements a logging utility for HAL (Hardware Abstraction Layer) components, including functions for generating log messages at various levels, initializing and terminating logging modules, and managing verbose logging settings based on environment variables and configuration files.

methods.name: void HALUTIL_Logger_Message(eMessageLevel level,const char * function,int line,const char * format,...)
methods.description: Generates and outputs a log message based on the provided log level, function name, line number, and format string with arguments.

methods.name: void HALUTIL_LogModuleInit()
methods.description: Initializes the logging module; sets verbose logging if configuration is detected.

methods.name: void HALUTIL_LogModuleTerminate()
methods.description: Terminates the logging module; logs termination message.
